cause: The standard Kodi launcher sources the system profile, whose BusyBox profile resets LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the system library directory. Service environment alone therefore did not select the isolated candidate runtime. The actual-library admission guard rejected it.
scope: Failed runtime admission, not output equality, QSV1, playback performance, or clean display restoration qualification. Original system launcher and profile were not modified. Private library maps and frames remain on target.
